test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements aptly defines 'high powered money'?

options.text: Money consumed by families or individuals.
The excess of total government consumption.
The currency issued by the Central Bank that can be held by the public or by the commercial banks.
Money collected from families or individuals and deposited in a bank.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The currency issued by the Central Bank that can be held by the public or by the commercial banks**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **High-powered money **is the **liability of the monetary authority **of **the country**.
 
• This is also called the **monetary base **and is **created **by the **RBI**.
 
• **High-powered money **includes **currency (notes and coins), **deposits with **the government, **and **reserves of commercial banks **with **RBI**. So, to sum up, high-powered money **is. H = C + R**
 
• The **other name **of the **Reserve Money is **“**High Powered Money**” and also **“Monetary Base”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are **4 major types of Money **:

 
 
• **Commodity Money**
 
• **Fiat Money**.
 
• **Fiduciary Money**.
 
• **Commercial Bank Money**.
